source_state: Whole current four-language Procurement design/fact baseline reviewed;original2026-07-27 decisions,phases and important history retained with applicability.Only this document family is approved,not the linked operation/developer Wiki.
method: Read all four complete 790-line original documents with clipped segments explicitly reread, inspect selected current source ranges and prior unchanged Core Flow16/17 evidence, then manually author and compare every replacement in all four languages. Review covers the whole resulting documents by retaining the fully read unchanged content and comparing all changed prose, tables, seven diagrams, sample JSON and navigation. Final generated ranges and Git diff were inspected; original idempotency bullets were restored rather than lost, unconditional FAILED wording was replaced, actual AwardRequest/AwardResult was made explicit, and the engineering-table labels were corrected in219b. Current source/file hashes and four complete Markdown renders bind this final result. Automated checks supplement the semantic decision; rendering alone does not award review.
source_inspection_scope: Selected current source ranges and all nine Controller mappings inspected directly;prior unchanged Core Flow16/17 evidence reused.Whole-file digests do not mean every implementation line or deployed behavior was inspected.

limitations: Authorized AI semantic review is not HUMAN_REVIEW or current runtime/release acceptance.
Selected inspected ranges and prior unchanged source evidence are bound; file hashes do not mean every implementation line was read.
Four full Markdown renders contain28 Mermaid fences; browser diagram layout and final root/subpath site remain G requirements.
Existing49reports/213passing assertions were reused without expensive rebuilds or repeated successful business writes.
Procurement operation/developer Wiki reviews remain separate;C OAuth,D real CAPTCHA,E native Qoder and all other pending A-G remain.

checks.coverage_and_meaning: 完整逐段覆盖16节：原设计日期/历史状态和分期、独立服务/Workflow边界、14表与Requester/Owner/子资源范围、物料/金额、六状态请购及四种启动状态、审批规则与真实任务资格、RFQ/报价/定点/PO/收货/质检/Asset回扫、50外部+3内部路径、十类采购事件、PII/日志/XSS、前端、当前工程入口、并发/降级、最低测试要求、原里程碑/ADR/风险。保留重要决策与历史计划并标记适用性；工程清单改为当前入口，实际操作和扩展指向既有Wiki，未批准对应Wiki整篇。
checks.technical_literals: 核对8106/19906/9906、omni_procurement、/api/procurement无StripPrefix、八个公共依赖及Workflow排除、14个实际表名含proc_event_inbox、完整四层MyBatis链、完整权限代码/Requesters与Owners、全部53方法路径、APPROVING/STARTED与requisitionId:attempt/实例任务校验、REQUIRES_NEW及原轮次重试、RFQ当前报价version/AwardRequest全字段与AwardResult、PO继承RFQ/GR当前scope归属、DECIMAL(19,6)/(19,4)/字符串JSON、PCS与LAPTOP例子、consumerName/eventId与来源单位唯一性、tenant/eventId及JSON语义意图、十类采购事件含cancelled、真实compose.yaml/application-lite.yml和首次CNY/13类初始化。49份现有报告213通过0跳过逐份摘要匹配，无重跑源码相同构建。
checks.security_and_failure_semantics: 四语均保留聚合特定scope、TenantLine和分页前DataPermission，不将owner条件拼所有子表。approval-view仅对当前APPROVING/STARTED的完整业务键/实例/本人任务资格临时TENANT读取并finally恢复，普通详情不复用例外。SUBMITTED取消只FAILED，采购cancel不终止Workflow；提交前解析失败回滚、提交后不确定尝试FAILED且标记可失败、FAILED不证明远程未启动。PO确认/取消是管理权限命令，无虚构门户确认/取消审批/close入口。PO详情真实返回完整PII且无独立PII授权；日志规则和XSS权威enabled/基线区分。收货实际锁头/PO+全租户累计+版本，行查询不因名字而锁行；质检终态重复为冲突，候选仅资产合格行。SRM历史重放、PO后续本地快照、Outbox可靠路径与实际投递、Inbox及来源幂等均限定范围。
checks.images_and_links: 本设计无光栅截图。每语七个Mermaid块，共28个，架构运输路径、ER逻辑关系、状态/事务边界和协议值已核对，人用标签本地化；图不宣称跨库外键。原日期与原计划保留，审批金额图明确为示例，原单金额优先风险不覆盖当前品类/金额规则。源码入口用真实文件/目录与四语Wiki/索引，旧application-dev.yml/docker-compose.yml已移除。Markdown渲染不是Mermaid浏览器布局或整站根/子路径验收；正式链接门仍需通过，G完整验收保留。
checks.language_and_terminology: 完整阅读原英文并对照中文与所有手写修订片段。统一requisition/requester、RFQ/award/quotation snapshot、receiver/owner、attempt/persisted intent/replay、conditional FAILED marking、local Outbox versus delivery。requires/only/attempts/not proof 保留失败与授权限定；完整保留半开审批区间、原模型金额示例、币种隔离、十进制字符串、资产候选游标和实际接口。

checks.technical_literals: 核对8106/19906/9906、omni_procurement、/api/procurement无StripPrefix、八个公共依赖及Workflow排除、14个实际表名含proc_event_inbox、完整四层MyBatis链、完整权限代码/Requesters与Owners、全部53方法路径、APPROVING/STARTED与requisitionId:attempt/实例任务校验、REQUIRES_NEW及原轮次重试、RFQ当前报价version/AwardRequest全字段与AwardResult、PO继承RFQ/GR当前scope归属、DECIMAL(19,6)/(19,4)/字符串JSON、PCS与LAPTOP例子、consumerName/eventId与来源单位唯一性、tenant/eventId及JSON语义意图、十类采购事件含cancelled、真实compose.yaml/application-lite.yml和首次CNY/13类初始化。49份现有报告213通过0跳过逐份摘要匹配，无重跑源码相同构建。
checks.security_and_failure_semantics: 四语均保留聚合特定scope、TenantLine和分页前DataPermission，不将owner条件拼所有子表。approval-view仅对当前APPROVING/STARTED的完整业务键/实例/本人任务资格临时TENANT读取并finally恢复，普通详情不复用例外。SUBMITTED取消只FAILED，采购cancel不终止Workflow；提交前解析失败回滚、提交后不确定尝试FAILED且标记可失败、FAILED不证明远程未启动。PO确认/取消是管理权限命令，无虚构门户确认/取消审批/close入口。PO详情真实返回完整PII且无独立PII授权；日志规则和XSS权威enabled/基线区分。收货实际锁头/PO+全租户累计+版本，行查询不因名字而锁行；质检终态重复为冲突，候选仅资产合格行。SRM历史重放、PO后续本地快照、Outbox可靠路径与实际投递、Inbox及来源幂等均限定范围。
checks.images_and_links: 本设计无光栅截图。每语七个Mermaid块，共28个，架构运输路径、ER逻辑关系、状态/事务边界和协议值已核对，人用标签本地化；图不宣称跨库外键。原日期与原计划保留，审批金额图明确为示例，原单金额优先风险不覆盖当前品类/金额规则。源码入口用真实文件/目录与四语Wiki/索引，旧application-dev.yml/docker-compose.yml已移除。Markdown渲染不是Mermaid浏览器布局或整站根/子路径验收；正式链接门仍需通过，G完整验收保留。
checks.language_and_terminology: 完整阅读韩文并对照全部修订。统一구매요청/조달/자재/품목、수령인/담당 귀속、선정/견적 버전、재실행/멱등성、로컬 트랜잭션/보안 기본값。修正印尼语jenis和발기误译，DDD 집계改애그리거트，七张图和目录说明采用韩文；保留실패 기록 시도、실제 상태 재조회、원격 미시작 증명 아님、别立PII权限不存在与历史规划边界。
